notes: Independent check 2026-11-12 (WebFetch of all 3 source_urls): 3 checked, 1 fixed, 0 removed, 0 downgraded. Fix: Vet Care Ltd street address (Plot 246 Ali Hassan Mwinyi Road) came only from an aggregator and is not on the ELT source page, so address reduced to 'Mikocheni, Dar es Salaam' and duty text no longer borrows ELT's appointment sentence. Vetzcapes and Pet Care House confirmed as on page (phones, location, no 24 h claim). Thin run: Tanzania has few clinic websites that WebFetch could open. No duty rotas, no animal poison line, no 24 h clinic found. Official bodies (Tanzania Veterinary Council, Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries, SUA teaching hospital) yielded no readable clinic data. Left: Delta Vets (deltavets.co.tz, redirect loop), Anivet (robots), Merlino Vet Clinic Arusha (named on an expat forum only, no site), Zanzibar, Moshi, Mwanza, Dodoma clinics not found. Follow-up 2026-11-12: searched Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam, Arusha/Moshi/Mwanza, SUA; opened expat.com (failed), expat.com business directory (no clinic data), Workaway Arusha vet host (paused profile, nothing), MAWO OSU page (mobile NGO, e-mail only). No new clinic with own opened page, no duty rota, no poison line, no 24 h clinic. Delta Vets and Anivet skipped as instructed. No entries added.
